column3: The Hebrew has an active reporting form with David named, followed by David saying his prayer; BSB makes someone tell David. The Hebrew uses an ordinary saying verb for the prayer.
The Hebrew repeats the names and title “Zadok and Abiathar the priests” and says “house”; BSB uses “them” and “palace.”
The Hebrew says to send word “by their hand”; BSB says to send the sons with the information.
The Hebrew says Hushai came to “the city” and Absalom to “Jerusalem”; BSB reverses these designations.
